<function name="status" parent="coroutine" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns the status of the coroutine passed to it, the possible statuses are "suspended", "running", and "dead".</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="coroutine" type="thread">Coroutine to check the status of.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="string">The coroutine's status.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
